caption.text:
Bupati Gowa, Sitti Husniah Talenrang, memenuhi panggilan Panitia Khusus (Pansus) sebagai terperiksa dalam sidang hak angket DPRD Gowa, Sulawesi Selatan, Selasa (14/7). Di tengah persidangan, Bupati Gowa tiba-tiba walkout atau meninggalkan sidang.

Dalam hak angket ini, terdapat tiga materi yang menjadi fokus penyelidikan DPRD Gowa:
1. Dugaan penyalahgunaan kewenangan dalam pencabutan beasiswa doktoral (S3) milik Rizqila.
2. Dugaan penyimpangan program pengadaan seragam sekolah gratis
3. Dugaan perbuatan tercela yang berkaitan dengan penyelenggaraan pemerintahan daerah.

Poin ketiga adalah soal dugaan perselingkuhan yang sebelumnya diungkapkan oleh suami Husnia, Khaerul Aco.

Bupati Gowa meminta anggota Pansus memberikan seluruh pertanyaan secara kolektif. Namun, anggota Pansus menolak permintaan tersebut. Mereka menginginkan Husniah menjawab pertanyaan poin per poin.

Namun, karena permintaannya tidak dipenuhi, orang nomor satu di Kabupaten Gowa itu memilih tidak melanjutkan persidangan. Husniah kemudian walkout karena merasa haknya tidak diberikan.
.
📸: Dok. YouTube DPRD Gowa.

caption.text_translation:
Regent of Gowa, Sitti Husniah Talenrang, fulfills the call of the Special Committee (Pansus) as examined in the hearing of the Gowa DPRD, South Sulawesi, Tuesday (14/7). In the middle of the hearing, Regent of Gowa suddenly walked out or left the hearing.

In this petition, there are three materials that are the focus of the Gowa DPRD research:
1. Allegations of abuse of authority in the revocation of Rizqila doctoral scholarship (S3).
2. Problems of deviation of the free school uniform procurement program
3. Allegation of negligent acts related to local government organization.

The third point is about the alleged affair that was previously revealed by Husnia's husband, Khaerul Aco.

Regent of Gowa asks Pansus members to give the whole question collectively. However, Pansus members rejected the request. They want Husniah to answer questions point by point.

However, because his request was not met, the number one person in Gowa County opted not to proceed with the hearing. Husniah then walked out because he felt he wasn't given his rights.
 . 
 📸: Dok. YouTube DPRD Gowa.
